description: This file defines the Header class within the OrangeHRM project's reporting module. The class manages a collection of columns (which can be of type Column or StackedColumn), handles meta information via ParameterBag, and provides methods for normalization and validation of column data.

classes.name: Header
classes.description: Represents a report header composed of columns; manages columns and associated metadata, ensuring type validation and providing normalization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Header with a given array of columns, validating and setting them.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Returns the array of columns in the header.

methods.name: setColumns
methods.description: Sets multiple columns, adding them individually with validation.

methods.name: addColumn
methods.description: Adds a single column to the header after validating its type.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Converts the header's columns to an array format for external use.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Retrieves the metadata associated with the header.

methods.name: setMeta
methods.description: Sets the metadata for the header.
